name: Is spray foam insulation safe for my home and family?

mainEntity.name: Is spray foam insulation safe for my home and family?

acceptedAnswer.text: When properly installed by certified professionals, spray foam insulation is safe. During the application process, the area must be cleared, and occupants should remain out of the home for a specified period, typically 24-48 hours, to allow for the curing process and proper ventilation. Once cured, spray foam is inert and does not off-gas harmful chemicals. Choosing an experienced contractor ensures correct application, adherence to safety protocols, and effective ventilation, mitigating any potential risks.
acceptedAnswer.description: When installed correctly by professionals and properly cured, spray foam insulation is safe. Occupants must vacate during application and for a specified period afterwards.
